:::{#thm-bernoulli-hessian-sum}
#### Hessian of a binary sample

If $\Outvar_\iobs \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $\iobs = 1, \dots, n$, with observed [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) $\outbar$,
the [Hessian](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-hessian) of the [log-likelihood](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-loglik) is the $1 \times 1$ matrix whose only entry is:

$$\hess(\prob) = -n \paren{\frac{\outbar}{\sqf{\prob}} + \frac{1 - \outbar}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-hessian-sum, worked in @sol-bernoulli-hessian-sum.

:::
